zudate

zudate brings the TC39 Temporal date/time model (Instant, PlainDate, PlainTime, PlainDateTime, ZonedDateTime, Duration) to R as vectorised classes, with all date/time logic delegated to the Rust crate jiff. The package is under active development towards 0.1.0; see roadmap.md for progress.

Building from source needs a Rust toolchain (cargo and rustc >= 1.81, see https://www.rust-lang.org/tools/install). All Rust dependencies are bundled, so no network access is needed during installation.

Installation

You can install the development version of zudate from GitHub with:

# install.packages("pak")
pak::pak("pedrobtz/zudate")

Example 

library(zudate)
head(available_time_zones())
